abilities.description: Shien: When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage} before a fight against a lightsaber-wielding foe, roll +spirit. If you do, take +2 momentum on a hit.

Makashi: If you are remaining defensive against a Force user, take +1. When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.2f2ba4090b22a122]{Enter the Fray} against a lightsaber or Force user, take +1 and do +1 harm. If you miss you must take an extra harm to yourself.

Niman (Jar'Kai): When it comes to lightsaber combat, you've seen it all, merging all previous styles into this style--the "Moderation Form". When you @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.a2d7793b23c17489]{Secure an Advantage} to determine an opponent's lightsaber style, take +1. When you dual-wield (a sub-style called Jar'Kai), take +2. It is very difficult for someone to disarm you, if you are ever disarmed, take +1 on a @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.e6ed148eff82c171]{Face Danger} to prevent/reclaim it.
